title: Hangover-Cure British Horseradish Welsh-Rarebit
description: A comforting, buttery Welsh rarebit recipe infused with the pungency of horseradish, perfect for curing a hangover.
instructions: In a medium saucepan, melt the butter over medium heat.
Add the horseradish and cook, stirring constantly, for 2 minutes.
Add the flour and cook, stirring constantly, for 1 minute.
Slowly pour in the milk, whisking continuously to avoid lumps.
Bring the mixture to a simmer and cook for 2 minutes, until slightly thickened.
Remove from heat and stir in the grated Gruyère cheese until melted and smooth.
Add the dry white wine, tadka spices, and black pepper, stirring to combine.
Transfer the sauce to a baking dish or individual ramekins, if using.
Bake in a preheated oven at 375°F (190°C) for 15 minutes, until golden brown and crispy on top.
Serve immediately, garnished with chopped parsley or chives if desired.
Serve with toasted bread or crackers, if desired.
